request.style: English, Sacred Harp shape-note singing, a loud raw congregation in four parts, no instruments, bare open harmony in a minor key, slow and stern, 3/2 feel, 76 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Lord, you have been our dwelling place
Through all the years gone by
Before the mountains rose in space
You were, and you are nigh

[Verse]
You turn us back to dust again
Return, you sons of men
A thousand years are in your sight
Like yesterday, like a watch in the night

[Verse]
We flourish like the morning grass
By evening it is dry
So teach us how our days will pass
That wise our hearts may lie
